meta.classification_note: Deposit classes are a rule-based screening of bulk APXS chemistry, not a mineral identification.

classes.label: Iron meteorite
classes.description: Iron-nickel metal that fell from space (Curiosity's Cururu and Allison Mine).

classes.label: Opaline silica
classes.rule: SiO2 ≥ 65 wt% with Na2O + K2O < 5 wt%
classes.description: Nearly pure silica, a signature of hot springs or acid leaching (Spirit's Kenosha Comets, Curiosity's Buckskin).

classes.label: Calcium-sulfate vein
classes.rule: SO3 ≥ 18, CaO ≥ 12 wt% and CaO/SO3 = 0.45–1.1 (≈ CaSO4)
classes.description: Gypsum or bassanite precipitated by groundwater in fractures (Opportunity's Homestake, Curiosity's white veins).

classes.label: Manganese-enriched
classes.description: Manganese oxides need strongly oxidizing water to form - a key clue about past habitability.

classes.label: Aluminous clay-like
classes.rule: Al2O3 ≥ 10, SiO2 ≥ 50, FeO ≤ 10, CaO ≤ 6 and Na2O + K2O < 4.5 wt%
classes.description: Leached, aluminium-rich rock consistent with clay minerals formed in water (Opportunity's Esperance).

classes.label: Silica-enriched halo
classes.rule: SiO2 55–65 wt% with Na2O + K2O < 5 wt%
classes.description: Rock altered by fluids that added silica, often along fractures (Curiosity's Lubango halos).

classes.label: Magnesium-sulfate-rich
classes.rule: SO3 ≥ 15, MgO ≥ 10 wt%, MgO/SO3 ≥ 0.35 and CaO < 8 wt%
classes.description: Mg-sulfate salts left as lakes and groundwater evaporated (Curiosity's sulfate-bearing unit).

classes.label: Iron-sulfate-rich
classes.description: Ferric sulfates from acid-sulfate alteration (Spirit's bright Paso Robles soils).

classes.label: Sulfate-rich sediment
classes.description: Sedimentary rock cemented by sulfate salts (Meridiani's Burns formation).

classes.label: Phosphate-rich
classes.description: Phosphorus-rich rocks such as Spirit's Wishstone class; phosphorus is a nutrient for life.

classes.label: Salt / halogen-enriched
classes.description: Chloride and bromide salts concentrated by evaporating brines.

classes.label: Zinc-enriched
classes.description: Zinc concentrated by hydrothermal or groundwater fluids (e.g. Curiosity's Kimberley sandstones).

classes.label: Iron-oxide-rich
classes.description: Iron-oxide rich material such as Opportunity's hematite 'blueberries'.

classes.label: Alkali-rich igneous
classes.rule: Na2O + K2O ≥ 5 wt% and SiO2 ≥ 46 wt%
classes.description: Feldspar-rich igneous rock, more evolved than typical Mars basalt (Curiosity's Jake_M).

classes.label: Olivine / Mg-rich
classes.description: Olivine- or carbonate-rich rocks high in magnesium (Spirit's Comanche outcrop).

classes.label: Basaltic soil & dust
classes.rule: Soil or sand without the signatures above
classes.description: Global Mars soil: basaltic sand mixed with fine oxidized dust.

classes.label: Basaltic rock / sediment
classes.description: Typical Mars bedrock: basalt and basalt-derived sandstones and mudstones.
